{{short description|British mathematician}}
'''Mary Lou Zeeman''' is a [[British people|British]] [[mathematician]] at [[Bowdoin College]] in the United States, where she is R. Wells Johnson Professor of Mathematics.{{r|bowfac|6pn}} She specializes in [[dynamical system]]s and their application to [[mathematical biology]]; she helped found the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]] Activity Group on the Mathematics of Planet Earth, and co-directs the Mathematics and Climate Research Network. {{r|mpe}}

Zeeman is the daughter of British mathematician [[Christopher Zeeman]].{{r|czo}}
She was educated at the [[University of Oxford]],{{r|6pn}} and earned her PhD in 1989 from the [[University of California, Berkeley]] under the supervision of [[Morris Hirsch]].{{r|mgp}} Before moving to Bowdoin in 2006, she spent 15 years on the faculty of the [[University of Texas at San Antonio]]. {{r|6pn|pims}}
